title: Zettelkasten Linkage
hook: Hundreds of saved notes and you can't find a single useful one when you need it.
statement: Link your notes together so they build a web of knowledge, not a pile.
explainer: A note on its own only tells you what it already says. The connections are where new ideas show up, the kind you never sat down to write.
sop: Pick one note tool that supports linking and stick with it.
Link every new note to 2 or 3 related ones.
Sample 10 notes and score Connectedness from 1 to 10.
Monthly, link or archive any note with zero links.
equation_example: No math, just a scale. Connectedness at 2, notes sit alone and get lost. At 8, one note leads to five more and patterns show up by themselves. Higher means your notes spark ideas. Lower means a storage bin you never open.
question: Pick one recent note and link it to two older ones today.
closing_statement: Linked notes teach you things lonely ones can't.
caption:
Principle Nº 224: Zettelkasten Linkage

Hundreds of saved notes and you can't find a single useful one when you need it.

Link your notes together so they build a web of knowledge, not a pile.

Your turn: Pick one recent note and link it to two older ones today.
